_doc: Phase 8a candidate config — Donchian Breakout 4h on BTC + ETH, Long-only with ATR-trailing-stop. Used ONLY by scripts/backtest_portfolio.py for evidence-based validation BEFORE going live. NOT loaded by the scheduler. After the backtest confirms Sharpe >= 0.8 in both the full window and an out-of-sample 2025+ split, these strategies are copied into /opt/go-trader/scheduler/config.json and the live scheduler is restarted.

_rationale.asset_choice: BTC + ETH only — highest liquidity in HL perps, longest data history, lowest correlation among major-cap crypto (~0.7 historical). Two assets = some diversification without forcing the runner to find too many edges.
_rationale.timeframe: 4h. Six bars per day = 5500 bars in 2.5 years. Low enough frequency that the 0.035% HL taker fee is negligible per trade. High enough that we get statistically meaningful trade counts (estimated 20-60 trades/year).
_rationale.strategy: donchian_breakout — classic Turtle Trading system with documented positive edge in trending crypto markets since 2010. No-lookahead shifted channel (verified in shared_strategies/open/donchian_breakout.py).
_rationale.params_entry_55_exit_20: Long-term Turtle (System 1 in the Dennis/Eckhardt paper). 55-bar entry on 4h = ~9 days lookback for new highs. 20-bar exit = ~3 days for tighter exit channel. Filters out 4h noise that would trigger 20/10 short-term Turtle.
_rationale.direction_long_only: V1 is long-only. Crypto trends are asymmetric — bull trends last months, bear trends are violent and short. Adding shorts before validating long-only would mix two different edges and make attribution impossible.
_rationale.stop_loss_atr_2x: Stop at avg_cost - 2*ATR(14) at entry, NOT trailing in V1. Turtle's original 2N stop. V2 can add trailing once we trust the entry/exit core.
_rationale.capital_5000_each: $5k per strategy of Bot-B's ~$80k paper balance. Total deployable: $10k = 12.5% of equity. Conservative on purpose — we don't size up until live performance confirms the backtest.
_rationale.no_leverage: leverage=1 (no leverage). Mathematical exposure to the asset, nothing more. Adding leverage before validating un-leveraged Sharpe is gambling, not trading.
